commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n apache2ctl configtest
printf 'effective_site_controls\n'
sudo -n grep -E '^(Listen|[[:space:]]*(Alias|RedirectMatch|Options|AuthType|AuthName|AuthBasicProvider|AuthUserFile|Require))' /etc/apache2/ports.conf /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/web-authentication-boundary.conf
printf 'apache_listeners\n'
sudo -n ss -ltnp | grep apache2
if sudo -n ss -ltnp | grep -q ':80[[:space:]]'; then exit 1; fi
printf 'port_80_listener=absent\nport_8080_listener=present\n'
